meaning:
ἐξ-ανα-τέλλω
[in LXX: Gen.2:9, Psa.104:14 Psa.132:17 Psa.147:8 (צָמַח hi.); Psa.112:4 (זָרַח) * ;]
1. trans., to cause to spring up (LXX).
2. Intrans. (as ἀνατέλλω, Gen.3:18), to spring up: Mat.13:5, Mrk.4:5.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.
Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.
